headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 9, 2026, the portfolio set has achieved an average return of 16.94%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 10.93%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 6.01%, indicating that the portfolio is not only growing in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 43.88%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 8.63%, still above the benchmark but less impactful. This relative strength is particularly notable during periods of macroeconomic uncertainty, showcasing the portfolio's resilience against broader market trends. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
